query:
SELECT
            l.path,
            k.prefix as key_prefix,
            l.timestamp,
            (CASE WHEN l.path LIKE '/graphql%' THEN 'GraphQL' ELSE 'REST' END) as "surface!"
        FROM api_request_logs l
        JOIN api_keys k ON l.api_key_id = k.id
        WHERE k.user_id = $1
        AND l.status_code = 429
        ORDER BY l.timestamp DESC
        LIMIT 10
